name: Nissa Revane
description: Nissa Revane is an elf animist and planeswalker of Zendikar's Joraga tribe, known for commanding the land and its elementals and for being a founding member of the Gatewatch.

summary.text: Nissa Revane is an elf animist and planeswalker of Zendikar's Joraga tribe, known for commanding the land and its elementals and for being a founding member of the Gatewatch.

bio.text: Nissa survived the Eldrazi devastation of her Joraga tribe, was rescued by Hamadi, and crushed a Pathrazer with earth elementals, and Hamadi told her that Zendikar had chosen her and that Shaya means Worldwaker.
Earlier, as a young animist, she bonded with Zendikar's soul, failed to destroy the dark knot, and had her spark ignite, hurling her to Lorwyn before she followed a thread home.

On Zendikar she fought the Eldrazi alongside the elemental Ashaya, learned she was one with the land, lost her connection when it was torn away, and restored Zendikar's soul by feeding Khalni Heart on Bala Ged.
She also freed the Eldrazi titans from their last bonds, hoping they would leave, and later helped trap Ulamog at Sea Gate before Ob Nixilis broke the trap.
She swore the Gatewatch oath, wove Zendikar's leylines into a glyph to bind the titans while sending the plane's mana through Chandra, and then left Zendikar with the Gatewatch.
After Bolas corrupted the leylines she controlled on Amonkhet and she fled, she quit the group on Dominaria, declaring her watch over.
She later opposed Nahiri over the lithoform core on Zendikar, merging with Ashaya and using the core to heal the plane.

The Phyrexians compleated her, and after being cleansed she woke having lost her spark and her connection to the planes, then mended her bond with Chandra and stepped through a portal with her hoping to find Zendikar.

status.text: As of the latest story that shows her, Nissa is alive but no longer a planeswalker, and she is Chandra's partner.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes pinned under a fallen tree after the Eldrazi swarm and Ulamog's return devastate her Joraga tribe.
timeline.quote: Eldrazi had swarmed the Joraga. There had been a great blast of energy. Ulamog had returned.

timeline.summary: Too drained to planeswalk, Nissa lies helpless as Ulamog's shadow passes over her, devouring the life from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Planeswalking was out of the question.

timeline.summary: A human man pulls Nissa from under the tree and heals her as Ulamog closes in; she blesses him and passes out.
timeline.quote: Stay alive. We'll get you out of here.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes in a tent, where Hamadi tells her the Joraga are no more.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry, but from what we saw, the Joraga are no more.

timeline.summary: Hamadi calls Nissa 'Shaya' as they climb a mountain together.
timeline.quote: I think highly of your will, Shaya,

timeline.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa how his people of Graypelt were destroyed by the Eldrazi, and Nissa, overcome by guilt, apologizes.
timeline.quote: She was responsible for all of it, all his loss and all of Zendikar's devastation.

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Hamadi, Bahkut, Alira and the kor twins Khali and Sha'heel, who rope the party for a climb through gravity fields of floating boulders.
timeline.quote: Once everyone was secured, they moved into the gravity fields.

timeline.summary: From their ropes the party sees a Pathrazer spawn of Ulamog emerge below to attack travelers, and Sha'heel drops toward it.
timeline.quote: Nissa looked over her shoulder to see Sha'heel pull out a knife and cut his anchor lines with one smooth motion.

timeline.summary: Nissa frees herself and rides vines down to the ground to fight the Pathrazer, which crushes several travelers.
timeline.quote: Before anyone could act, the Pathrazer had grabbed several of the expedition and crushed them in its tentacled hand.

timeline.summary: Khali and Sha'heel snare the Pathrazer with ropes while Nissa pours all her power into earth elementals that crush it.
timeline.quote: the other two hulks bludgeoned the Pathrazer into a wriggling mass of unrecognizable flesh.

timeline.summary: Hamadi tells Nissa that Zendikar has chosen her and that Shaya means Worldwaker.
timeline.quote: It means 'Worldwaker.'

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Ugin that over a thousand years have passed and the Eldrazi have escaped their hedron prison on Zendikar, partly through Nissa's choice.
timeline.quote: They're free." Sorin had the urge to press the matter, to needle Ugin, to make someone else shoulder the blame.

timeline.summary: The Magic Origins storyline is announced: five Planeswalkers' emotional awakenings, which ignited their sparks, across ten planes.
timeline.quote: Each of these characters experienced an emotional awakening powerful enough to ignite their spark and change their lives forever.

timeline.summary: The five origin stories are scheduled in order: Chandra, Liliana, Jace, Gideon, Nissa.
timeline.quote: Over the next five weeks, you'll be able to read all five origin stories in this column.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes from a vision of a black knot choking a stream of living light, in her bed at home.
timeline.quote: Nissa awoke with a start, screaming and gasping for breath.

timeline.summary: Nissa overhears Numa tell her mother he must send them away because of her visions.
timeline.quote: "I have no choice, Meroe. I cannot risk Zendikar's retribution. I'm sorry. Truly, I am."

timeline.summary: Nissa slips away from camp at night, hiding her trail so the horror will find only her.
timeline.quote: she would not lead the horror to those she loved.

timeline.summary: A shimmering stream like the one in her vision appears and wraps around Nissa like a cocoon; she connects with Zendikar's soul.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane connected with Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Nissa's vision shows a glowing version of herself facing the dark knot in a mountain before a bright light consumes all.
timeline.quote: a bright light blasted through the whole vision

timeline.summary: Mazik finds Nissa and reveals he followed her with her mother's knowledge; Nissa realizes Zendikar is in pain and wants her help.
timeline.quote: Zendikar isn't after me.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Mazik follow the stream out of the forest and across the canyons, running short of water.
timeline.quote: Together, they followed the stream of glowing light deeper into the forest.

timeline.summary: Vampires attack in the bog and Nissa leads Mazik to flight along the stream, but Mazik is separated and trapped in a tree.
timeline.quote: Five vampiric horrors loped after them.

timeline.summary: Nissa unexpectedly summons a huge land elemental, controls it, and kills the vampire leader with vines.
timeline.quote: they pierced the vampire straight through his heart.

timeline.summary: Nissa practices her new powers while crossing the foothills of Akoum.
timeline.quote: Mazik encouraged Nissa to practice using her new powers.

timeline.summary: The glowing stream vanishes and the Roil strikes, shaking the land violently.
timeline.quote: "The Roil! It's happening!"

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes the Roil is Zendikar's fear of the dark knot and calms the land by humming her mother's animist song.
timeline.quote: It was an animist song, the tune that her mother had hummed to her so many times.

timeline.summary: Zendikar forms an elemental from the land to guide Nissa and Mazik to the dark knot.
timeline.quote: a fully formed elemental stepped out of the earth.

timeline.summary: At the ring of floating hedrons around the highest peak, Mazik falls ill and Nissa must go on alone.
timeline.quote: "I want you to go. I'll be okay. We'll be okay."

timeline.summary: Nissa channels Zendikar's power in a massive blast at the mountain but it has no effect.
timeline.quote: it was as though her spell had done nothing.

timeline.summary: The dark knot's madness shows Nissa the monster inside, and her spark ignites, hurling her from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: something inside her cracked, like an egg breaking open

timeline.summary: Nissa lands on Lorwyn and sees the coming blight in a vision.
timeline.quote: Lorwyn, it called itself.

timeline.summary: Nissa is found by the elves of the blight hunt led by Dwynen and joins the hunt.
timeline.quote: Take up your blade and prove yourself.

timeline.summary: Galed kills boggarts despite Nissa's pleas, and Nissa feels one die.
timeline.quote: And then she felt it die.

timeline.summary: Nissa turns her blade on Galed and Dwynen turns on her, just as Shadowmoor arrives.
timeline.quote: How dare you come to my forest and tell me what I can do?

timeline.summary: The Great Aurora of Shadowmoor sweeps over Lorwyn and transforms Dwynen as she is about to shoot Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dwynen was paralyzed, caught in the Great Aurora of Shadowmoor.

timeline.summary: Nissa resists a voice tempting her to stay and, chanting Zendikar, steps through the void and follows a thread home.
timeline.quote: It pulled her with great force through the tear in the fabric of Lorwyn and out into the void.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya watch from a ridge over the Vastwood Forest, looking at the white corruption left by Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi drained the life and essence from all the living things they encountered.

timeline.summary: Nissa names the elemental Ashaya, the Awoken World, after Hamadi's name for her.
timeline.quote: "Okay then, Ashaya it is," Nissa said.

timeline.summary: Nissa questions why Zendikar chose her again after she failed the first time, and Ashaya repeats its confusing gesture.
timeline.quote: I failed. Last time you chose me, I failed.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya hear screams and see Eldrazi attacking a small encampment.
timeline.quote: "There!" Nissa pointed.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya crush the first Eldrazi, fight the tentacled one and cripple it, but the third carries off the kor, who is consumed.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi consumed the kor's life, turning her still, pale body into dust.

timeline.summary: A vampire consoles Nissa, reveals he knows her name and her spark, and tells her the world is ending.
timeline.quote: "That is fair considering your history with vampires, Nissa."

timeline.summary: The vampire offers four seeds from Anowon, including the last bloodbriar of Bala Ged, asking Nissa to take them to another plane.
timeline.quote: "Kolya, red mangrove, jaddi, bloodbriar."

timeline.summary: Nissa takes the seeds as the vampire argues no effort can beat the titans; Ashaya watches, and the vampire vanishes.
timeline.quote: She took the seeds.

timeline.summary: Mimicking Ashaya's gesture, Nissa sees glowing leylines stream from her fingers and understands Zendikar did not choose her but she is one with it.
timeline.quote: These were the leylines

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she was never chosen or alone but one with Zendikar and cries 'For Zendikar!', charging into the forest bonded to the land.
timeline.quote: "For Zendikar!" she cried

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the one-tentacled Eldrazi with a spear of land and a punch from Ashaya.
timeline.quote: The horror let out a final deflating chitter as it collapsed.

timeline.summary: Nissa rides Ashaya and calls an army of baloth-sized elementals as they hunt an Eldrazi titan.
timeline.quote: an army of baloth-sized elementals took shape.

timeline.summary: Ashaya relays a distress call from Fartree Hamlet, and Nissa and Ashaya rush to help, finding three Eldrazi instead of two.
timeline.quote: But the chatter was wrong; there were three Eldrazi, not two.

timeline.summary: Nissa chooses to attack the twin Eldrazi at the hamlet first, planning to reach the heart trees after.
timeline.quote: "We have to give the most help we can give,"

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya rescue the humans from the treehouses by bending a tree and shielding them with a wall of land.
timeline.quote: Nissa pulled on the tree, urging it to bend to her.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya kill the first twin Eldrazi by snapping the tree into its faceplate and gutting it.
timeline.quote: Its limbs went limp, and then the monstrous thing teetered back and crashed to the forest floor.

timeline.summary: Nissa rips the second twin apart with root tentacles and saves the humans from its falling body.
timeline.quote: carried the people back and away as the Eldrazi struck the ground.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya arrive too late at the thicket, where the Eldrazi has killed all but two heart trees, and then kill it.
timeline.quote: The monster was both killed and buried in the same stroke.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya promise the last heart tree that Zendikar will fight on, and they press on in pursuit of the titan.
timeline.quote: Zendikar would fight back.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya are struck by terrible pain as the connection to Zendikar is torn away, and Ashaya collapses and shatters.
timeline.quote: Nissa watched as Ashaya's branches snapped and shattered on the ground.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes in silence, unable to feel Zendikar or Ashaya, and stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: But there was nothing there to grasp.

timeline.summary: A wounded merfolk saves Nissa from walking into an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It was a merfolk, one clad in thick, sharp armor made of seashells.

timeline.summary: Nissa carries Jori En and fights with her sword, but without Zendikar's help she is pinned by an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She pulled on her arm with her all, but the tentacle was too heavy.

timeline.summary: Kor on a floating rock rescue Nissa and Jori with hooked ropes.
timeline.quote: The next moment the tentacle was pulled off of her

timeline.summary: A huge Eldrazi lands on the rock and Gideon appears, lashing it away with his sural and hauling everyone up.
timeline.quote: four glowing, white whips fly through the air and lash into the Eldrazi's side.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jori reunite, and he leads the survivors across floating rocks to a nearby encampment.
timeline.quote: "Jori En!" The Planeswalker cried out

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Gideon her connection to Zendikar was ripped away, but Gideon says his power is unchanged.
timeline.quote: "Mine is gone. It was ripped away.

timeline.summary: Gideon is welcomed at the encampment with the rescued survivors while Nissa reaches out and finds Zendikar silent and empty.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was empty.

timeline.summary: Jace says they must go to the Eye of Ugin; Gideon refuses to leave the encampment and Jace reveals Nissa has left.
timeline.quote: "We already have," said Jace. "Nissa left in the night."

timeline.summary: Nissa keeps vigil each twilight at the bluff where Zendikar was torn from her, finding only emptiness.
timeline.quote: She kept vigil there, returning each day to ground herself

timeline.summary: Nissa recalls that Gideon and Jace did not understand her account of Zendikar's lost soul.
timeline.quote: She had told them that something horrible had happened to Zendikar's soul.

timeline.summary: A fleeing goblin warns Nissa of a swarm of Eldrazi, and Nissa fights them with only her sword to protect the clearing.
timeline.quote: She stepped forward to stand between the precious piece of land and the monsters.

timeline.summary: Nissa nearly planeswalks away from the swarm but refuses because it would mean it was over.
timeline.quote: But leaving would mean that it was over.

timeline.summary: Munda arrives and helps kill the swarm, and Nissa joins him in tracking the goblin.
timeline.quote: a hook on a chain rushed past her and plunged into one of the Eldrazi

timeline.summary: Munda tells Nissa about Gideon's army and his plan to retake Sea Gate; Nissa silently disagrees with 'taking back' Zendikar.
timeline.quote: As one, we'll reclaim Sea Gate.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Munda find Pili at a hidden cave where a group of goblins is trapped, and free them; Leek is dead.
timeline.quote: Three bodies were lined up against the wall.

timeline.summary: Pili grieves for Leek, and Nissa comforts her.
timeline.quote: Nissa had never hugged a goblin before.

timeline.summary: Pili's insistence that she knew inspires Nissa to realize Zendikar's soul may have retreated to Khalni Heart.
timeline.quote: If something had happened, if the titan had threatened the world's soul, that's where it would have run to.

timeline.summary: Nissa slips away from the goblins and planeswalks to Bala Ged to find Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Nissa planeswalked away—back home, back to Bala Ged, to find Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Nissa arrives on Bala Ged and finds it entirely consumed by white corruption.
timeline.quote: The land wasn't ruined—it had been entirely consumed.

timeline.summary: Nissa walks to the site of her old village and is overwhelmed by memories of her past self and her departure.
timeline.quote: She wouldn't be that elf again, she couldn't be.

timeline.summary: Nissa instinctively kills a gomazoa-like Eldrazi and realizes it must have fed on life, leading her toward Khalni Heart.
timeline.quote: She quartered the monstrosity so quickly

timeline.summary: Following the Eldrazi's trail to a surrakar cave, Nissa finds a moss-lined tunnel.
timeline.quote: she saw the first sign of life.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds a ring of hedrons imprisoning the wilted Khalni Heart and realizes someone uprooted Zendikar's soul.
timeline.quote: someone had uprooted the land's soul and trapped it here to die.

timeline.summary: A demon attacks Nissa, mistaking her for Nahiri's emissary, and they fight.
timeline.quote: "Was it Nahiri?"

timeline.summary: Nissa unleashes her wild essence to reflect the demon's life-draining blast.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, the full force of Nissa's essence came rushing back to her

timeline.summary: The demon reveals he plans to seize Khalni Heart's power, and Nissa breaks a hedron to open the prison.
timeline.quote: the massive rock shattered.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Khalni Heart but the demon traps her and tells her to planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: "If you want to live, now is the time to planeswalk away."

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes she is neither her old self nor her controlled self and pours her essence into Khalni Heart, letting it root in the land.
timeline.quote: Nissa collected all the power left within her

timeline.summary: The land swallows Khalni Heart and Zendikar's soul returns to the land, defeating the demon's plan.
timeline.quote: The world's soul had returned to the land.

timeline.summary: Nissa drives a fist of land into the demon and rises with Ashaya, who returns as her friend.
timeline.quote: Nissa rose up, and so too did the world's soul, her friend.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya set off to return to Sea Gate and join Gideon's battle cry.
timeline.quote: Nissa and Ashaya would return to Sea Gate, they would meet Gideon's army

timeline.summary: Elementals of tree and stone march through Sea Gate crushing the Eldrazi, and Gideon sees that Nissa has returned bringing Zendikar with her.
timeline.quote: Nissa had returned. And she had indeed brought Zendikar with her.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

timeline.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
timeline.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

timeline.summary: Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
timeline.quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns Nissa to lead land forces and Kiora to coordinate a sea attack.
timeline.quote: you will coordinate a sea attack.

timeline.summary: Jace pitches the hedron trap, but Kiora insists on attacking with the bident and Nissa objects to trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: One hedron alone isn't enough

timeline.summary: Jace warns that a failed assault could drive Ulamog onto another world, but Kiora strikes at him with the bident and leaves on a tentacle; Gideon deflects the blow.
timeline.quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

timeline.summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

timeline.summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
timeline.quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

timeline.summary: The ring fails to light because of a misaligned hedron.
timeline.quote: The ring didn't flare to life like it was supposed to.

timeline.summary: Nissa shares Jace's mind and illusion, and they locate the tilted hedron; Nissa leaps to it.
timeline.quote: The hedron was tilted; it must have shifted sometime after being carefully locked into place.

timeline.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
timeline.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

timeline.summary: The Zendikari cheer that Ulamog is trapped.
timeline.quote: They had done it. Ulamog was trapped.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis wakes buried alive after Nissa took Khalni Heart and collapsed the cavern on him.
timeline.quote: She left me alive.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis recalls his failed plan to synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Synchronize a hedron network with Khalni Heart, and use it to channel enough planar energy through my body to reignite my spark.

timeline.summary: He recovers the keystone hedron of his network and uses it to sense where the last stand will be.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate, if memory served. A lovely place for a slaughter.

timeline.summary: He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
timeline.quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns with Nissa to seal the Eye, but Nissa breaks the last bonds and the Eldrazi titans emerge.
timeline.quote: she broke the last bonds holding them in, and the titans emerged into the world.

timeline.summary: Nissa loses her connection to Zendikar's soul and agrees to meet the others outside Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: But her connection to Zendikar's elemental soul had suddenly vanished

timeline.summary: Nissa finds the Khalni Heart in Bala Ged, restores her connection to Zendikar and defeats Ob Nixilis.
timeline.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis , removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and left the demon seething underground.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

timeline.summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
timeline.quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

timeline.summary: Nissa calls on Ashaya, but Ashaya cracks and crumbles and the world shakes.
timeline.quote: Then something broke.

timeline.summary: The seawall heaves, the hedron ring shakes, and a stray hedron with dark power breaks a leyline.
timeline.quote: The circle was broken.

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to complete the broken circle with her own body but is struck down by Ulamog's tentacle.
timeline.quote: Nissa only saw the thick, pink tentacle after it had struck her.

timeline.summary: The rest of the ring collapses and Ulamog, free again, moves toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Ulamog, free of his bonds, was moving toward Sea Gate once more.

timeline.summary: Nissa recognizes the demon from Bala Ged as the cause of the collapse as he casts a great spell.
timeline.quote: He was the cause of all of this.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis calls a second titan, Kozilek, up from the ground.
timeline.quote: The demon had called yet another horror to ravage her world.

timeline.summary: Nissa surrenders to rage and runs at the demon through Kozilek's distortion and the toppling lighthouse.
timeline.quote: Kozilek's flailing arm had smashed into the seawall

timeline.summary: Nissa tackles Ob Nixilis with her blade at his neck, but he escapes and drains her with essence magic.
timeline.quote: sending a tide of his essence-draining magic down at Nissa.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis uses spawn of Kozilek to cut Nissa off from Zendikar and the leylines.
timeline.quote: She was cut off from Zendikar. Powerless.

timeline.summary: Vision of the future: Tazri serves Kozilek and watches him kill Gideon, the other planeswalkers lying dead.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura burst, and a bloody bag of ruptured flesh and broken bones fell limply to the ash-white earth below

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
timeline.quote: I'm inviting myself,

timeline.summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
timeline.quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
timeline.quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

timeline.summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

timeline.summary: Gideon leads the planeswalkers out of the cavern and they scatter the Eldrazi swarm at the cave mouth.
timeline.quote: Gideon was the first to emerge from the cavern

timeline.summary: Jace stops Gideon from making empty promises to a distraught Nissa.
timeline.quote: Don't make promises you can't keep,

timeline.summary: Jace suggests leaving Zendikar to its fate, and Nissa refuses and the ground trembles.
timeline.quote: I'm not going anywhere,

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes none of them have left and argues that together the four can stand against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But maybe four of us can,

timeline.summary: Gideon swears an oath to keep watch against all threats to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: For Sea Gate, for Zendikar and all its people, for justice and peace, I will keep watch.

timeline.summary: Nissa swears the oath to keep watch.
timeline.quote: for the life of every plane, I will keep watch.

timeline.summary: Chandra swears the oath, saying every world has its tyrants, and Nissa embraces her.
timeline.quote: If it means that people can live in freedom, yeah, I'll keep watch.

timeline.summary: The four set out to find Tazri and form a plan.
timeline.quote: I left Tazri and a small group of soldiers a couple miles back that way.

timeline.summary: The four planeswalkers enter a ravine covered in Kozilek's trail and find Tazri, Munda, Jori En, Kiora and Drana's emissary arguing over a strike plan.
timeline.quote: Standing tall, bident in hand, cocky smile still in place, was the merfolk Planeswalker Kiora

timeline.summary: Jace presents half a plan with the glyph that Ugin showed him, since a hedron trap for two titans is impossible.
timeline.quote: It's no longer possible to trap Kozilek and Ulamog,

timeline.summary: Jace explains Ugin's metaphor and concludes the titans can be pulled fully into the physical world to be killed.
timeline.quote: we pull the two titans into the physical world completely, and then we can kill them.

timeline.summary: Nissa shares her mind and memories with Jace, showing how the hedron network contained the titans and how the Roil was the world fighting back.
timeline.quote: She'd thought her world was angry. She hadn't realized it was fighting for its life.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Jace conceive a plan to drain the titans' energy into Zendikar's leylines without hedrons, so the plane can devour them.
timeline.quote: So this world can do to them what they 've been trying to do to it.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she removed the last failsafe and let the Eldrazi out, and Jace confesses he was part of the reason the failsafe was needed.
timeline.quote: I let them out, said Nissa.

timeline.summary: Jace lays out the plan: lure the titans into an ambush, bind them with Nissa's leylines, and drain them, with Kiora clearing the basin and Chandra told not to attack the titans.
timeline.quote: When the time comes, Nissa weaves the leylines together and binds the titans.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that the titans may get bigger as they are drawn into physical space, and Kiora agrees to follow the plan with a warning.
timeline.quote: Meaning they may get, um, bigger,

timeline.summary: Jace rallies the rear guard troops with Nissa, telling them they are the most important people on the battlefield.
timeline.quote: She'll be binding the titans, and ultimately she'll be the one who kills them.

timeline.summary: Chandra serves breakfast heated with her hands, and Nissa brings blankets for her to warm.
timeline.quote: the blankets warmed.

timeline.summary: Ugin lands furiously among the Zendikari, demanding to know what Jace has done.
timeline.quote: What have you done?

timeline.summary: Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
timeline.quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

timeline.summary: Chandra talks Nissa into leaving Zendikar with the Gatewatch, saying Nissa can still protect it by standing with them.
timeline.quote: No one else can do it,

timeline.summary: Nissa visits the glyph at night and plants four seeds, including a Jaddi tree and a bloodbriar, at its center.
timeline.quote: One by one she planted them in the holes she had dug.

timeline.summary: Nissa promises Zendikar's soul she will see it again and moves toward the others, agreeing to show Jace what she knows of Sorin.
timeline.quote: I will see you again,

timeline.summary: Chandra leads the group that baits Ulamog, while Gideon leads the other bait army toward Kozilek, toward Jace and Nissa waiting in the titans' path.
timeline.quote: The plan involved being as noticeably, tantalizingly alive as possible

timeline.summary: The two bait armies cross in front of Nissa and Jace, and Jace signals them to disperse.
timeline.quote: Disperse the army. The titans are in position!

timeline.summary: Nissa lights with magic and weaves Zendikar's leylines into a tripartite glyph that lashes around the titans.
timeline.quote: A tripartite glyph a hundred feet wide appeared on the floor of the valley in fierce green fire.

timeline.summary: The leylines go taut and hold the titans, who shriek and shake the earth, but the spell absorbs all of Zendikar's mana.
timeline.quote: But then the leylines snapped taut.

timeline.summary: Cracks spread through the titans as the glyph erodes them, but Zendikar breaks faster and floating landmasses begin to fall.
timeline.quote: The titans, finally, were beginning to break.

timeline.summary: Kiora argues that Zendikar will die with the titans and demands Nissa let them go; Jace insists they must be destroyed here.
timeline.quote: Zendikar will perish if they do.

timeline.summary: Gideon sides with Chandra, and Jace asks Chandra if she is certain she can destroy the titans with one spell.
timeline.quote: I'm certain

timeline.summary: Kiora empties the Halimar Sea and hurls it at Nissa, but Jace splits it into mist.
timeline.quote: But the sea split in two, and each half split in two

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's shoulder, sending the mana of all Zendikar through her, and Chandra ignites the leylines.
timeline.quote: The leylines themselves caught fire

timeline.summary: Survivors gather in the ash with no celebration, and Kiora leaves with the bident.
timeline.quote: And she didn't stop walking for a long time.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Nissa arrive, and Jace lays out the plan: Nissa taps the leylines with her glyph, Gideon clears a path, and Chandra channels the energy.
timeline.quote: Nissa will use her planar glyph to tap into the leyline network.

timeline.summary: Nissa warns the plan will fail because the leylines have been redirected into the cryptolith network at Thraben, and after listening she agrees she can do it.
timeline.quote: "It's not going to work. The leylines have already been redirected. Into that."

timeline.summary: Nissa begins the planar glyph in the market square while Gideon charges the horde to protect her.
timeline.quote: He roared a challenge as he slashed in a wide circle

timeline.summary: Nissa pulls up three spectral vines to tap the leylines; the third, darker vine strangles her.
timeline.quote: it had managed to wrap itself around her neck

timeline.summary: Nissa cries out and collapses; the glyph goes dark and the plan fails as the horde keeps coming.
timeline.quote: The glyph went instantly dark.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Gideon recoil from the Chain Veil, while Chandra defends Liliana as having saved them.
timeline.quote: "That...thing she carries. It's an abomination."

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.
timeline.quote: in that shifting Emrakul unfolded

timeline.summary: The other planeswalkers collapse under Emrakul's mental assault, except Jace, who casts a spell in response.
timeline.quote: The other Planeswalkers crumpled, all except Jace, who cast some type of spell in response.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Nissa mutated by Emrakul, ranting that growth is the answer, and she tells him she can do anything she wants.
timeline.quote: I can do anything I want. Anything at all.

timeline.summary: Jace links the group's minds; Jace and Nissa tell Chandra that burning Emrakul will not work.
timeline.quote: Trying to burn Emrakul is throwing a torch into the ocean.

timeline.summary: Nissa agrees to power the spell because Jace freed her mind from Emrakul's darkness.
timeline.quote: But I owe you, Jace Beleren. I will try.

timeline.summary: Nissa collapses having drained the leylines, and the spell is about to fail.
timeline.quote: It was not going to be enough.

timeline.summary: Liliana notes Nissa has barely left the roof garden since the first morning.
timeline.quote: She's been staying in the roof garden ever since.

timeline.summary: In the courtyard Nissa conjures a bush-beast that drives Gideon into the ground, testing his indestructibility.
timeline.quote: Its front limbs interlaced into a single fist, which it drove down on Gideon like an avalanche.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Nissa if his habit of clapping shoulders makes her uncomfortable and promises to stop.
timeline.quote: That thing I do, where I clap people on the shoulder? Does that make you uncomfortable?

timeline.summary: Liliana bristles that Nissa gets apologies while she once had to learn to break fingers.
timeline.quote: Two hundred years ago, she'd had to learn to break fingers.

timeline.summary: Chandra remembers floating in green when she touched Nissa's mind and is drawn to seek her out.
timeline.quote: She was floating in green and I could breathe there.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds Nissa sitting on moss in her flower-filled room.
timeline.quote: She's sitting cross-legged on a patch of moss.

timeline.summary: Chandra clumsily tells Nissa that on Zendikar she felt Nissa's calm mind behind the world's anger.
timeline.quote: But behind Zendikar, behind the anger and the power, I felt you

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to teach Chandra to meditate.
timeline.quote: I can teach you to meditate, if you wish.

timeline.summary: Mortified, Chandra flees Nissa's room.
timeline.quote: I turn and run, trailing sparks, trees and flowers smearing around me, banging through the door.

timeline.summary: Nissa, daydreaming of waking as a seed in the dark, is jolted back by Gideon at dinner.
timeline.quote: I'm not a seed.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Baan about what Nissa and Chandra did on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I was telling Minister Baan what you did on Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels overwhelmed and alone among the crowds of Ravnica, cut off from Zendikar's voice.
timeline.quote: She'd never been among so many, and never been so alone.

timeline.summary: Baan contrasts aether with leylines, and Nissa explains that on her world they ask rather than take.
timeline.quote: We don't take.

timeline.summary: Nissa says Chandra's past was hers to share, since everyone has scars others should not touch.
timeline.quote: We all have scars we don't want others to touch.

timeline.summary: Lavinia stops Jace from leaving to find Chandra, saying Gideon and Nissa can search for Monk Nalaar.
timeline.quote: They can find Monk Nalaar.

timeline.summary: Nissa volunteers to go to Kaladesh with Baan and stand with Chandra.
timeline.quote: I'll stand with her.

timeline.summary: Nissa's vines topple guards moving on Chandra.
timeline.quote: Several of them toppled, feet tangled in a hissing whirl of flowered vines

timeline.summary: Nissa angrily confronts Liliana for leaving without telling the others.
timeline.quote: Why did you leave without letting us know?

timeline.summary: Liliana cruelly tells Nissa that Chandra ran from her and came to Liliana.
timeline.quote: She ran from you

timeline.summary: Oviya Pashiri comforts Chandra and says they will free her mother from the Consulate.
timeline.quote: when we find your mother and take her back from those Consulate soldiers, Chandra.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri brings Chandra and Nissa to Yahenni's party.
timeline.quote: this is Chandra and Nissa

timeline.summary: Yahenni takes Nissa to the roof and explains that aetherborn are the city's own natural beings.
timeline.quote: We are the city. I'm made of aether, and one day, I'll return to it.

timeline.summary: Nissa senses that this world is structured and cyclical.
timeline.quote: This world is structured. Cyclical.

timeline.summary: Yahenni offers Chandra and Nissa information in return for removing the enforcer and breaking the door.
timeline.quote: I'll give you the information you need if you'll help me.

timeline.summary: A potted plant coils around the enforcer's leg and he falls dazed.
timeline.quote: The potted plant by the door is inexplicably wrapped around the enforcer's leg

timeline.summary: Nissa carries the enforcer outside.
timeline.quote: easily hoists the man over her shoulders in a fireman's carry

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri leads Chandra and Nissa to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath it.
timeline.quote: I'm told the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath the night market.

timeline.summary: On a skiff across the river, Nissa thinks of Ashaya and of her place in the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: She thought of Ashaya then, her elemental companion, a fragment of the world-soul of Zendikar

timeline.summary: Chandra rejects Nissa's offer of calm and says she only wants to find her mother.
timeline.quote: I want to find my mom.

timeline.summary: Nissa works out that the way aether flows through the city can guide them to the Dhund.
timeline.quote: It has to do with the way aether flows through the city.

timeline.summary: Concentrating, Nissa perceives the plane's aether as a vast river network and tracks a trickle from underground tunnels.
timeline.quote: The world suddenly sprawled vast across her awareness, like a map unrolled and spread upon a table.

timeline.summary: Chandra kicks down a guard while Nissa's vines dismantle his automaton.
timeline.quote: Vines broke through the concrete floor and coiled around its legs

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she cannot find Pia directly in the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Finding your mother down here is another matter entirely.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

timeline.summary: Chandra erupts at Mrs. Pashiri for leading them around in circles.
timeline.quote: You've been leading us around in circles while they have my mom?

timeline.summary: Chandra steps through an illusory wall and discovers it is not real.
timeline.quote: disappearing through the stone as if it were a wall of water

timeline.summary: Beyond the illusion, the tunnels become clean, well-lit corridors lined with bureaucrats' offices.
timeline.quote: The tunnel network was utterly transformed.

timeline.summary: Armored figures surround them and a scarred man, Baral, unmasks.
timeline.quote: One of the figures reached up and pulled off a filigree mask that covered his face.

timeline.summary: Baral raises walls that trap the three in a sealed chamber.
timeline.quote: she slammed into a wall that shot up from the floor

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's back and briefly feels Chandra's fire in her soul.
timeline.quote: A channel opened between them

timeline.summary: Chandra's wave of fire reflects back on her, and Nissa shields Mrs. Pashiri with her cloak.
timeline.quote: throwing her cloak over Mrs. Pashiri and trying to shield the older woman with her body

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes poison vapor is leaking into the cell to suffocate them faster.
timeline.quote: He means for us to suffocate more quickly after all.

timeline.summary: Cut off from the earth, Nissa recalls her only other equal isolation, when Ob Nixilis tore Ashaya from her (flashback).
timeline.quote: when the demon Ob Nixilis had disrupted the ley lines on Zendikar and torn Ashaya from her

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to fuel Chandra's fire with her mana to try to melt the door's hinges.
timeline.quote: Let me fuel your fire,

timeline.summary: Their focused flame fails against the counterspell and fizzles out.
timeline.quote: the last flames fizzling out in her hand

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch is about not being alone and having a family on any plane.
timeline.quote: Having a family, no matter what plane we're on.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave the dying Mrs. Pashiri, and Nissa says she will stay with them, thinking of Chandra as her friend.
timeline.quote: I'll stay here with Mrs. Pashiri.

timeline.summary: Ajani sees a hand weakly strike the window of a poison box, and realizes it holds his friends.
timeline.quote: A fist struck the glass. Then a hand, weakly.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Grandmother Pashiri barely breathing.
timeline.quote: Grandmother lay eyes closed and barely breathing.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Chandra's poisoned blood and lungs.
timeline.quote: Silver tendrils of healing magic raced through her, cleansing the impurities

timeline.summary: As guards assemble, a rope drops through the window and Ajani leads them out.
timeline.quote: We have a ride,

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
timeline.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

timeline.summary: Chandra decides to face Tezzeret's challenge despite the risk of another trap.
timeline.quote: He's calling me out,

timeline.summary: Jace, Liliana and Gideon, disguised as Consulate soldiers, drop their illusions and reunite with Chandra, Nissa, Ajani and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: It seems this is a matter for the Gatewatch,

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra it is over, and Chandra runs into her mother's arms.
timeline.quote: Her mother held her arms open. Chandra ran and fell into them.

timeline.summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
timeline.quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

timeline.summary: Nissa follows her friend Chandra to Kaladesh to help.
timeline.quote: Nissa follows to help.

timeline.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
timeline.quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane storms in and rescues them from the cell.
timeline.quote: the door to the cell flies open, and in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

timeline.summary: Jace causes Yahenni a body ache on the ladder until Nissa and Chandra recognize them and let them into the hideout.
timeline.quote: "Yahenni!" Chandra yells while opening the hatch and pulling me through.

timeline.summary: Chandra introduces Yahenni to Jace, Liliana and Gideon; Chandra says they got her mother free.
timeline.quote: Yahenni, this man is Jace, this woman is Liliana, and the man in the corner is Gideon.

timeline.summary: Yahenni warns that the Consulate is on its way and offers their penthouse as a safe hideout; the group agrees.
timeline.quote: My penthouse is safe.

timeline.summary: Nissa has Gideon call back Chandra, who walked the wrong way, and directs the group to Yahenni's home and sends word to Ajani, Pia and Mrs. Pashiri.
timeline.quote: Tell Chandra Yahenni's home is that way, and have Jace inform Ajani, Pia, and Mrs. Pashiri of our new location

timeline.summary: Nissa comforts Yahenni with a current of land energy, telling them they are her friend; Yahenni resolves to do good with their remaining days.
timeline.quote: "Because you are my friend," she says delicately.

timeline.summary: Ajani and the rest of the group arrive after hearing the commotion.
timeline.quote: "We all heard the commotion."

timeline.summary: Nissa and Yahenni confirm an unusual flux of aether is being diverted from the Aether Hub to the Spire's reservoir.
timeline.quote: Miss Nissa and I have recently determined an unusual flux of aether being diverted to that particular reservoir from the Aether Hub.

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns roles: Pia and Chandra mobilize the renegades while he, Nissa, Jace and Ajani create disruption against the Consulate.
timeline.quote: We're going to run disruption until the renegades are ready to begin the assault.

timeline.summary: Consulate forces arrive and Gideon readies to fight.
timeline.quote: "They're there! Stop them!"

timeline.summary: Gideon keeps Chandra on the ship while Nissa and Ajani join Pia on the ground team.
timeline.quote: "I'll go along with the ground team," Ajani said.

timeline.summary: Pia's team meets Mrs. Pashiri, who gives them a crate containing a weapon against the turret, and brings renegade inventors.
timeline.quote: "A weapon against the Consulate," Mrs. Pashiri said.

timeline.summary: The ground team fights through automata and peacewalkers around the turret; Shadowblayde is caught in a peacewalker's treads.
timeline.quote: She lost her footing and fell sideways, dragged toward the spikes as she struggled to release herself.

timeline.summary: Ajani frees Shadowblayde from the treads and Nissa lifts the peacewalker to save them.
timeline.quote: Nissa stood under the chassis, her arms holding up the great mechanical beast

timeline.summary: At Yahenni's penthouse the Gatewatch gather before the party; Gideon forces himself to smile.
timeline.quote: Nonetheless, even here where no one but his friends could see him, Gideon smiled.

timeline.summary: Liliana's briefing on Tezzeret and Amonkhet leads the Gatewatch to discuss stopping Bolas, whom Liliana says controls and may have created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: "Bolas controls the place completely. As far as I know, he created it."

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch, except an unsure Nissa, vote to strike at Bolas now; Gideon decides to meet Ajani after facing Bolas.
timeline.quote: "Then we'll meet Ajani there...after we face Bolas."

timeline.summary: Nissa channels land energy to ease Yahenni's pain and tells them that aetherborn are the substance connecting the Multiverse and that she is from Zendikar.
timeline.quote: You are what connects the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Yahenni gives Nissa a pendant necklace with a sapphire from Lathnu.
timeline.quote: Nissa holds out a delicate hand to take the necklace.

timeline.summary: Nissa, meditating on the Spire platform, hears skywhales and tells Chandra she lacks the words but wants to be her friend.
timeline.quote: "...your friend."

timeline.summary: Nissa guides Chandra through a calming river visualization and Chandra falls asleep; Nissa watches over her.
timeline.quote: Carefully, Nissa lifted Chandra's radiant featherweight

timeline.summary: In meditation Nissa witnesses a new aetherborn form from aether and guides them to the other aetherborn, hearing an echo of Yahenni.
timeline.quote: The aetherborn looked at their hands, then at Nissa's flowers.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch's five planeswalkers appear in the middle of an Amonkhet sandstorm.
timeline.quote: Five figures stood where none were moments ago, caught by surprise in the blinding sands.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on a Kaladesh rooftop, after Ajani leaves, the Gatewatch plans to go to Amonkhet, with Liliana navigating, to find and stop Bolas.
timeline.quote: We go to Amonkhet and learn what we can of Nicol Bolas's plans, then neutralize the threat he poses

timeline.summary: Flashback: the five planeswalk from Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: We traveled infinitely far yet not at all, standing still yet moving at blinding speeds.

timeline.summary: Chandra melts sand into a glass dome to shelter the group from the storm.
timeline.quote: I step forward and shape the still-liquid glass into a simple, crude dome.

timeline.summary: Liliana admits she knows little of where Bolas is; Nissa senses the plane's leylines are weak, and Chandra spots Bolas's horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: the massive shadow of two horns pierces the sky

timeline.summary: Nissa senses Amonkhet's life magic is dominated by death.
timeline.quote: the shadow of death dominated all I could reach, as if the world itself favored the silence of the dead.

timeline.summary: Undead burst from the sand and grab Jace; the group fights a horde while Liliana commands undead to obey, assist and flee.
timeline.quote: rotting hands burst forth from the sand, grabbed Jace by the legs, and pulled him under.

timeline.summary: Gideon, buried under undead, is rescued by Nissa and the two fight toward Chandra.
timeline.quote: Suddenly the limbs of the zombie holding my right arm were no longer attached to its torso.

timeline.summary: Nissa kills a wurm by driving her sword into its skull.
timeline.quote: she drove her sword with both hands down, piercing its skull with a squish

timeline.summary: A dead wurm reanimates, strikes Chandra and Jace, and Nissa senses the world is under an ancient curse inverting life and death.
timeline.quote: This world suffered an ancient, powerful curse.

timeline.summary: Two zombified wurms attack; one coils around Nissa while Liliana lies in danger, forcing Gideon to choose.
timeline.quote: I stood, suspended, for a fraction of a second, fully aware that not making a choice meant choosing death for them both.

timeline.summary: A blazing white arrow kills the wurm over Liliana and a towering jackal-headed figure destroys the others and saves the group.
timeline.quote: She towered above me, standing at the height of a dozen men, golden headdress gleaming in the sun

timeline.summary: The group reaches a ridge and sees a barrier-shielded city of obelisks and temples on a river.
timeline.quote: all of which formed a sprawling city that spanned as far as we could see.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch decides to descend toward the city and its barrier.
timeline.quote: "Only one way to find out."

timeline.summary: Nissa finds Chandra in Gideon's arms, and Chandra awkwardly tries to explain.
timeline.quote: Nissa sets a plate of eggplant and potato curry on one of the benches

timeline.summary: Baral's amplified voice taunts Chandra about her father's death and her mother's imprisonment, goading her into running out; Nissa follows.
timeline.quote: Have you told your friends the story? About how you got daddy killed?

timeline.summary: Gideon, torn, asks Nissa to keep Chandra safe and returns to the Hub's defenses.
timeline.quote: "Keep her safe."

timeline.summary: Chandra turns the thorn wall into a fire and injures her arm; Nissa's vines and elemental destroy Baral's thopters.
timeline.quote: A trio of vines leapt up from the neighboring streets, raining debris.

timeline.summary: Baral confronts Chandra and Nissa on a rooftop; Nissa fights his automatons with a sword and Baral nearly kills Chandra with his blade.
timeline.quote: The blade falls.

timeline.summary: Nissa embraces Chandra and talks her down from detonating, guiding her to put out the fire through a memory of floating in a quarry.
timeline.quote: "Don't leave us," Nissa says, softly. "You're loved."

timeline.summary: Nissa's elemental batters Baral, and the women escape.
timeline.quote: A tree slammed into him from the left.

timeline.summary: Gideon, ruminating on whether the gods are Bolas's agents or his opponents, trudges through the desert with the group.
timeline.quote: To see gods wading amidst the horrors of the desert had not been among them.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra clear zombies at the dome and Jace and Nissa open a hole in the Hekma, and the group enters the city.
timeline.quote: a hole a little wider than Jace's outstretched arms opened to admit them.

timeline.summary: In a vision Nissa hears Amonkhet's soul describe its curse and the catacombs from which Bolas took their dead.
timeline.quote: I protected the vessels to keep their souls alive and he took. . . them . . .

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes, finds the plane's soul painful to touch, and asks Chandra to search for the shouting woman.
timeline.quote: "I'm going to go on a walk to find the woman from yesterday.

timeline.summary: A mummy bursts in with breakfast, startling the group.
timeline.quote: a white-bandaged mummy burst through the door carrying a tray of bread and a carafe of what smelled like ale.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra walk through Naktamun, noting that everyone is a trainee under twenty and mummies do all the labor.
timeline.quote: The enchanted dead were the ones who did all the work.

timeline.summary: Nissa, feeling ill, confesses to Chandra that she is learning what friendship means; Chandra says she wants to be a good friend.
timeline.quote: "I am thankful for your companionship.

timeline.summary: Hapatra introduces herself at Rhonas's Monument and explains that preserved bodies are enchanted to serve the living while they train for the Trials.
timeline.quote: We preserve the bodies left behind, and since training for the Trials is our mortal duty, we enchant the vessels to act in service to humanity.

timeline.summary: Hapatra reveals the God-Pharaoh's return and the Hours begin when the sun rests between the horns, any day now.
timeline.quote: "The Hours will begin when the sun rests between the horns. I'd estimate any day now."

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra realize they have two days to find answers and follow Nissa's sense of the woman's energy toward an alley.
timeline.quote: felt the tug of the woman's energy through what was left of the leylines.

timeline.summary: In an old alley, Nissa sees carved glyphs showing eight gods and a recently added horns sigil, concluding Bolas corrupted rather than created Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas didn't create this world , she realized, he corrupted it.

timeline.summary: Oketra appears, forbids approaching the sarcophagi, and Nissa tells her telepathically that her world is dying; Oketra shows fear and has no memory of before.
timeline.quote: " These sarcophagi are forbidden to approach ," Oketra said out loud.

timeline.summary: Gideon reveals he is competing in the Trials as Oketra's Champion despite Chandra's objections.
timeline.quote: "These gods are good at their core. I want to prove myself to them."

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Chandra that Bolas corrupted Amonkhet only decades ago, and they resolve to learn what he changed and to speak with Kefnet.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas must have come and gone only a few decades ago.

timeline.summary: Nissa wanders the beautiful, empty city and uses her mana sense to perceive the dark strain strangling Amonkhet's leylines.
timeline.quote: A dark virulent strain wove its way through the leylines.

timeline.summary: Nissa opens her eyes to find a statue of Kefnet, whose doors swing open with blue light, and she steps inside.
timeline.quote: a pair of large limestone doors swung open.

timeline.summary: A young man in the anteroom tries to probe Nissa's mind, fails, and admits she is not from here.
timeline.quote: You . . . you . . . are not from here,

timeline.summary: Nissa is struck by the fear that she herself brings the blight and failure to every plane she visits.
timeline.quote: She had failed to protect Zendikar. Failed to overcome Emrakul.

timeline.summary: The young man tells her she may attempt the Trial of Knowledge; Nissa panics, flings him against the wall, and runs into the blue light.
timeline.quote: she flung him against the stone walls.

timeline.summary: In the trial Nissa suffers a nightmare of an angel who says she can do anything, a voice she realizes was both Emrakul's and her own.
timeline.quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

timeline.summary: Through a cascade of nightmares, Nissa hears an inner voice telling her to stop, and realizes she is trapped in the trial's illusion.
timeline.quote: There had been one nightmare after another, each one cascading into the next.

timeline.summary: Nissa studies the leyline structure of the trap, finds a tiny gap with her eyes shut, widens it and steps through.
timeline.quote: In the weavings of magic surrounding her, there was a tiny gap.

timeline.summary: Seeing through the illusions, Nissa witnesses a vision of a dark snake's shadow swearing to drain every world, starting with Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: For what I require, I would drain every world.

timeline.summary: Nissa sees a vision of eight stars, three of which go dark, leaving a pattern like horns.
timeline.quote: Their new outline suggested a pair of horns.

timeline.summary: Visions show mummies mining blue ore, three children swallowed by the sands, a line of darkness stretching through thousands of worlds, and a golden sun disc crumbling.
timeline.quote: she saw an unbroken line of darkness from Amonkhet all the way back to the beginning of the line.

timeline.summary: The illusory angel appears, asks if Nissa is pawn or queen, and tells her to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.
timeline.quote: Stop being a piece, Nissa. Be the hand that moves.

timeline.summary: Kefnet appears and furiously demands who mocks his trial.
timeline.quote: It was the god himself, Kefnet.

timeline.summary: Kefnet plucks Nissa's thoughts and tells her knowledge is earned, offering dissolution as kindness to the unworthy.
timeline.quote: Dissolution is my kindness for you.

timeline.summary: Nissa recognizes that Kefnet is made of corrupted leylines, and weaves a spell that adds a new fiber of mana to them, altering him so he no longer wants to destroy her.
timeline.quote: She pulled it, and added a new fiber of mana to its mix.

timeline.summary: Kefnet declares she has passed her trial and flies away.
timeline.quote: You have passed your trial.

timeline.summary: Nissa resolves to stop being a pawn, notes the pattern she left in Kefnet, dispels the illusions, and leaves the temple.
timeline.quote: She was tired of being a pawn, constantly reacting to nightmares and failures, never ahead.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch share information with Samut, learning that Bolas is a dragon from another world and has tampered with the gods.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh is a dragon from another world, Samut.

timeline.summary: Liliana reveals her third demon is on Amonkhet, and the Gatewatch quarrel angrily.
timeline.quote: My third demon is here.

timeline.summary: The dissidents awake in the arena with cartouches of control, and Nissa learns to move against the cartouche by treating it like a leyline.
timeline.quote: They work like leylines

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch fight without magic, and Samut reaches Djeru and fights alongside him.
timeline.quote: She would protect him. They would fight together.

timeline.summary: Razaketh commands Liliana to come to him, and her body wades into the river of blood against her will; Chandra and Nissa are repelled by necromantic energy.
timeline.quote: her body waded forward into the river of blood.

timeline.summary: Razaketh dislocates Liliana's shoulder and silences her until Nissa's elemental breaks his concentration.
timeline.quote: A massive elemental emerged, its body forming from the banks of the river.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Chandra approach coldly, and Nissa warns that the bloodspell began a chain reaction that sets the Hours in motion.
timeline.quote: The Hours' that herald Nicol Bolas's return needed to be set in motion by the demon.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch resolves to find a vantage to ambush Bolas, and the others return to Naktamun, regarding Liliana coldly.
timeline.quote: Let us seek a better vantage to prepare for Nicol Bolas's arrival,

timeline.summary: Gideon, in rage, demands they fight Bolas at once, and the Gatewatch attack with everything they have.
timeline.quote: They began. Gideon charged, his golden force shield shimmering

timeline.summary: Liliana urges the others to retreat, then asks Bolas where he wants her to go, and flees, betraying Chandra's trust.
timeline.quote: Where . . . where do you want me to go?

timeline.summary: Nissa raises spurs and a giant earth elemental against Bolas, but he crushes Chandra in his claw and shatters her defenses.
timeline.quote: He swooped in and grabbed her in a huge claw.

timeline.summary: Bolas strangles Nissa with necrotic tendrils, and she tells Chandra to flee; Chandra planeswalks away injured.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away in a fiery blaze

timeline.summary: Bolas corrupts the leylines Nissa controls, and Gideon's interruption lets her flee the plane.
timeline.quote: She used Gideon's interruption to flee from this dead husk of a world.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dominaria coalesced around Gideon and the first thing that struck him was the stench of rotting plants and dank earth.

timeline.summary: Chandra asks where Jace is and Nissa says he has given up.
timeline.quote: He's given up.

timeline.summary: Nissa accuses Liliana of running after killing her demon Razaketh and using the group to free herself.
timeline.quote: You got what you wanted and ran.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks Nissa to rouse Yavimaya's treefolk against the Cabal's Stronghold while she uses the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: And I can use the Chain Veil to kill him.

timeline.summary: Nissa refuses and walks away, declaring her watch over.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry, but my watch is over.

timeline.summary: Nissa planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nissa was already stepping out of the plane.

timeline.summary: Chandra reveals she sensed Jaya Ballard's aether trail on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Just after Nissa disappeared, Chandra had noticed fresh traces of a powerful pyromancer's aether trail on Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Chandra uses Nissa's visualization to calm Multani, who regains awareness and recovers.
timeline.quote: The angry gold light from his eyes and mouth faded to a deep blue, and she was sure she saw awareness there.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya, Teyo and Nissa through secret routes past the Eternals on the way to Selesnya.
timeline.quote: I know most of the secret routes through Ravnica

timeline.summary: Teyo shields the group while Nissa asks an old birch tree to kill a crop of Eternals.
timeline.quote: Teyo put up a shield, and from behind it, Miss Revane asked permission of an old birch tree

timeline.summary: The group finds the Selesnya Conclave fortified and hostile, with Nissa blamed for awakening Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: We found the Conclave well and truly fortified. And unwelcoming.

timeline.summary: Boruvo carries Rat to her friends and through the Ledev line, and demands that Nissa be sent away; Nissa leaves to join Gideon.
timeline.quote: I've never been very good at talking. You two go with the centaur. I'll join Gideon.

timeline.summary: Kaya realizes Rat is invisible to Nissa and nearly everyone, and Rat explains that she is insignificant by birth magic.
timeline.quote: I'm not invisible. I'm insignificant . A rat.

timeline.summary: Nissa says she can repair the leylines now that the Bridge is gone.
timeline.quote: I believe I can repair them and help Ravnica reassert herself.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

timeline.summary: Operation Desperation activates and Niv-Mizzet's bones ignite; the light draws a God-Eternal.
timeline.quote: it had attracted the attention of one of the God-Eternals

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden overhears and backs the plan, and Chandra sets off with Rai, Nissa and guildmembers.
timeline.quote: They set off for New Prahv.

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra wrap Gideon's armor in leaves and the Gatewatch leads a solemn procession.
timeline.quote: wrapped Mister Jura's armor in the leaves

timeline.summary: Nissa joins Nahiri on the pillar and Nahiri says she may have a solution to heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Something that will heal Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Nissa race up the Skyclave; Nahiri's stairs collapse and Nissa saves her with a vine.
timeline.quote: "Got you," Nissa murmured.

timeline.summary: They reach the Skyclave, and Nissa, haunted by Gideon's death, asks how they will find what they need.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, how are we going to find what we need in such a vast place?

timeline.summary: A felidar ambushes Nahiri in a darkened chamber; Nissa distracts it and Nahiri chains and kills it.
timeline.quote: Nahiri drove all seven blades into the felidar, making certain to hit its vulnerable points this time.

timeline.summary: Nissa calls a fern elemental that agrees to guide them to the Skyclave's heart.
timeline.quote: She closed her eyes and felt its life under her fingers

timeline.summary: The elemental taps a geopede trap and Nissa and Nahiri kill the fallen creature.
timeline.quote: The monster shrieked and twitched. Then it went limp and expired.

timeline.summary: In the heart of the Skyclave, Nahiri takes the key and reveals she seeks the last lithoform core; the key points to a Skyclave in Murasa.
timeline.quote: It roughly translates to lithoform core . And it's the last one in existence.

timeline.summary: Nahiri uses the key's power to stop the Roil and partly mend the Skyclave, but the fern elemental withers and dies.
timeline.quote: Roil shuddered and stopped completely.

timeline.summary: Nissa demands the key; the two planeswalkers fight, and Nissa leaves for Ravnica.
timeline.quote: I can't just stand by and let this plane tear itself apart!

timeline.summary: Nissa asks Jace to help convince Nahiri to destroy the core, but Jace wants to study it and does not listen.
timeline.quote: I need Nahiri to destroy the lithoform core when she finds it.

timeline.summary: Nissa declares she will protect her home with or without the Gatewatch and planeswalks back to Zendikar.
timeline.quote: I'm going to protect my home. With or without the Gatewatch's help.

timeline.summary: Nissa's harabaz elemental destroys the monster, saving Jace.
timeline.quote: Within seconds, the harabaz elemental destroyed the monster

timeline.summary: Jace agrees to join Nissa in climbing the Skyclave to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Yes," he said. "I'm ready.

timeline.summary: Nissa catches Akiri in a bramble and hauls her onto a ladder of branches.
timeline.quote: there was a bramble branch curled tightly around her chest

timeline.summary: Akiri realizes Nissa and Jace are planeswalkers, and learns Nahiri has the Core.
timeline.quote: I've met Nahiri. She's the one who pushed me.

timeline.summary: Nissa senses that Nahiri went north, and Jace reveals he read her mind: she is going to the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She's going to the Singing City.

timeline.summary: Nissa goes ahead alone on jurworrell roots, vowing to stop Nahiri and destroy the Core.
timeline.quote: I will stop Nahiri and destroy the Core,

timeline.summary: Nahiri and Jace find the focal point destroyed, and Nissa arrives with Ashaya, claiming the elementals destroyed it.
timeline.quote: It was," Nissa replied, coldly, "until the elementals destroyed it.

timeline.summary: Nissa feels betrayed when Jace sides partly with Nahiri; Nahiri hurls swords at Nissa.
timeline.quote: Nahiri created dozens and dozens of glowing swords.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Ashaya merge in full power and attack Nahiri, who flees with Jace through the city.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the Wild seemed to swell with strength, with the drive to protect.

timeline.summary: Nissa and the elementals, speeding along Zendikar's paths, cut them off at the city gates.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is where I belong. It's the heart of my power and strength,

timeline.summary: The elementals surge forward as the battle for Zendikar's soul begins.
timeline.quote: The battle for Zendikar's soul had begun, and it would be a ruthless fight.

timeline.summary: Nissa, backed by Kazandu elementals, confronts Jace and Nahiri and orders the elementals to defend Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Defend Zendikar," she said to the elementals

timeline.summary: Nahiri battles the elementals but is overwhelmed, her swords brushed aside, and retreats into the Singing City.
timeline.quote: She didn't stop until she reached the massive marble gates of the Singing City and pushed through them.

timeline.summary: Jace escapes the city with the Core, but Ashaya pins him and tosses the Core to Nissa.
timeline.quote: And into Nissa's waiting hands.

timeline.summary: Nissa speaks mind-to-mind with Jace while the Core's voice, which is Zendikar itself, speaks to her.
timeline.quote: I am me. I am you.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes Jace is trying to take control of her mind, snaps the link and has Ashaya hold him down.
timeline.quote: Jace was trying to take control of her mind.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Nahiri that Nahiri is what Zendikar once was and Nissa is what it is now.
timeline.quote: You are what Zendikar once was, Nahiri. I am what it is now.

timeline.summary: Nissa merges her magic with the Core, colliding with Nahiri's hedrons and flattening the Singing City.
timeline.quote: Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

timeline.summary: The Core's power heals Zendikar, reviving the elementals and making the Eldrazi wastes bloom.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was healing, turning into something healthier, stronger than it was before the battle with the Eldrazi.

timeline.summary: Nissa races to Bala Ged along the leylines, finally home.
timeline.quote: Nissa was finally home.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra arrive at the tower and Elspeth hands them to Kaya for debriefing.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane and Chandra Nalaar walked into the light.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian skyship overpowers the watchtowers, and Elspeth orders Wrenn and Nissa to protect Teferi.
timeline.quote: Wrenn and Nissa, protect Teferi at all costs.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Chandra discuss the situation with Kaya and Saheeli: Jace's alliance is gathering and the Mirrans are about to attack.
timeline.quote: Jace has it on good authority that the Mirrans are going to launch their offensive very soon,

timeline.summary: Kaya explains the Phyrexians' World Tree plan and says they need the sylex to destroy it.
timeline.quote: If the Phyrexians have created their own tree, we'll need something powerful to destroy it,

timeline.summary: Chandra says no cost is too high to destroy the Phyrexians, clashing with Nissa and Saheeli.
timeline.quote: My point is that destroying the Phyrexians is the most important thing. No cost is too high.

timeline.summary: Teferi appears and says he is ready, and Chandra later admits she wants all Phyrexians to die.
timeline.quote: I want them all to die. All of them.

timeline.summary: At night Nissa, Wrenn and construct guardians hold the tower hall against Phyrexians who cross the threshold.
timeline.quote: Over two dozen Phyrexians had met with similar fates in the tower hall

timeline.summary: A pillar of light scorches the sky and steam covers the vale, leaving Elspeth and Jodah's fate unknown.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a pillar of light scorched the sky outside the tower like a sun ascending

timeline.summary: A second army of white-armored Phyrexians led by a flying winged general advances from the east.
timeline.quote: Out of the haze emerged a battalion of knights, more than a hundred strong

timeline.summary: Nissa commands the mechanical soldiers to meet the army, but nature spirits refuse her call and leylines are tangled.
timeline.quote: They recoiled at her presence.

timeline.summary: The constructs and Phyrexians clash, and the Phyrexians fight with unusual tactics, pinning the machines.
timeline.quote: The armies collided with sharp staccato thunderclaps.

timeline.summary: Nissa lends Wrenn and Seven her strength and Seven hurls her at the flying Phyrexian general, whom she stabs repeatedly with a seed-bearing sword.
timeline.quote: With each stab, she'd implanted a seed within the Phyrexian

timeline.summary: Nissa and the general fall, Seven catches her, but she is dragged down by Phyrexians and reaches into the ground for the Worldsoul, Gaea.
timeline.quote: Help! Help us! she called out

timeline.summary: Gaea's nature spirits call Nissa a meddler, then judge her and grant her power, filling her with the wrath of Gaea.
timeline.quote: Gaea has judged you

timeline.summary: Gaea's will transmutes fallen constructs and Phyrexians into heartwood warriors that pour onto the battlefield and push back the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Gaea's would-be destroyers now reassembled themselves

timeline.summary: Nissa kills the crippled Phyrexian general with vines, after Wrenn urges her to stop, deciding she must be decisive when the time comes.
timeline.quote: The vines obeyed her command.

timeline.summary: Nissa and Wrenn find Nahiri and Jace in the workshop with the wrecked Temporal Anchor, whose powerstone has imploded.
timeline.quote: The powerstone imploded and overloaded the anchor,

timeline.summary: Jace links the strike team telepathically, and Nissa finds a tiny artifact bird, resolving to keep watch for every plane.
timeline.quote: For the life of every plane,

timeline.summary: Jace says Nissa was shunted away by a trap, as if forced to planeswalk again.
timeline.quote: a trap shunted her away

timeline.summary: Lukka follows an angry cry and finds Nissa and the Wanderer fighting a Phyrexian construct on a bough.
timeline.quote: Lukka had seen them before: Nissa, and the woman was called . . . the Wanderer.

timeline.summary: Lukka proposes using the dominated Phyrexian as a guide and Nissa reluctantly agrees after he promises to kill it at any sign of trouble.
timeline.quote: if I get so much as a stomachache, I'll end the creature.

timeline.summary: Lukka and Nissa ride the centaur hulk up a tree, with Lukka irritated by Nissa's heels and recalling a childhood beating.
timeline.quote: Five to one.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer warns them of a Phyrexian monstrosity that attacks Nissa; the centaur hulk wraps wires around Lukka's spine and he kills the attacker with his harpoon.
timeline.quote: Veiny wires sprouted from its torso, plunging through his skin and wiggling through his gut to wrap around his spine.

timeline.summary: The group is attacked by leech-like creatures and a mother-beast; Lukka frees his Phyrexian by slicing through the mother-monstrosity with his now-metallic hands.
timeline.quote: He pulled apart a lip of flesh and freed his Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Vorinclex is nearby and recovered from his journey to Kaldheim, and Lukka and Nissa decide to attack him.
timeline.quote: We need to take him down before he hurts anyone else.

timeline.summary: At the center of the maze they find Vorinclex sparring joyfully with Glissa.
timeline.quote: Vorinclex fought a Phyrexian elf beneath the monstrous skulls that hung from the ceiling.

timeline.summary: Lukka charges in against Glissa while Nissa fights Vorinclex.
timeline.quote: Without another word, Lukka charged in.

timeline.summary: Nissa, horrified, backs away as Lukka advances on her, and the Wanderer flickers in to shield her and tells her to run.
timeline.quote: Nissa, run!

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells them New Phyrexia's invasion is upon them before she flickers away.
